card.name: Space before osmolarity limits
card.fires_on: Mostly the space right after 'osmolarity of' or 'less than', just before a number like 900 mOsm/L in IV nutrition labeling. Also fires on a few other spots such as an opening parenthesis after a drug class name.

modes.label: Osmolarity threshold
modes.description: The gap after 'osmolarity of' or 'less than' where an osmolarity number comes next.

modes.label: Other scattered spots
modes.description: A parenthesis after a drug class name, or a section number, in labeling text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word pieces like 'os', as in osmolarity or mOsm, which suits the osmolarity context.
card.plain: It lights up just before the number in IV fluid osmolarity limits, such as 'osmolarity of 900 mOsm/L'.
